envelope.description: Declare the approval types and the new Tool and ToolDeps fields

body.title: Declare the approval types and the new Tool and ToolDeps fields
body.summary: Add ApprovalClass (none, common, destructive), CommonApprovalMode (manual, edit-auto, auto), ApprovalRequest { requestId, toolId, approvalClass, repoPath, arguments, preview, reason, expiresAt }, ApprovalAnswer, ApprovalDenial (declined, timed-out, no-client, cancelled) and ApprovalGate beside the s2 types in src/daemon/tools, plus the optional Tool.approval (a class or a per-input function) and the optional ToolDeps.caller ('agent' | 'daemon' | 'workflow') and approvalMode. requiresApproval and destructive stay for now, so nothing else changes.
acceptanceChecks: npm run build compiles with the four ToolDeps builders and every builtin unchanged
ApprovalDenial has exactly declined, timed-out, no-client and cancelled and is assignable to s2's ToolDenialReason
no existing Tool, ToolResult or ToolDeps field changes meaning, and tool ids and input schemas are unchanged

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/approval-types.test.ts: ApprovalDenial holds exactly the four values and ToolDeps accepts caller and approvalMode
